question: The Vindhyachal Thermal Power Station is located in which one of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singrauli**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vindhyachal Super Thermal Power Station -**

 
 
• It is located in** the Singrauli district** of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is the **coal-fired power station** of the National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC).
 
• At present, it is **the largest (4760 MW) thermal power** plant in India.
 
• It is located about** 222 km south of Varanasi.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Indore -**

 
 
• Indore is a city in the state of** Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is the** largest city** of Madhya Pradesh in** terms of population.**
 
 
 
• **Pune -**
 
 
• Pune is an **important city **in the Indian state of Maharashtra.
 
• Pune is the **sixth-largest city i**n India and the **second-largest city **in Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Bhopal -**
 
 
• Bhopal is the** capital of the state** of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• It is the **administrative headquarters **of the Bhopal district.​
